<dd><p>Mark a release as canceled (never shipped).</p>
<p>Refuses to cancel a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">released</span></code> record unless <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">force_released_unshipped</span></code>
is set, because <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">released</span></code> implies the release shipped. Canceled releases
are excluded from previous-version inference and from default changelog
builds, but remain visible in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release</span> <span class="pre">list</span></code> as an audit tombstone.</p>
</dd></dl>

<dd><p>Inspect the release predecessor chain and report problems.</p>
<p>Reported problem kinds: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">missing_previous</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">self_previous</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">future_previous</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">canceled_previous</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">root_has_previous</span></code>. Returns
a deterministic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release_chain_check</span></code> payload; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ok</span></code> is True when no
problems were found.</p>
</dd></dl>

<dd><p>Rename a release from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">old_version</span></code> to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">new_version</span></code>.</p>
<p>Moves the release bundle, rewrites the release and entry front matter to
the new version, optionally rewrites successor <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">previous_version</span></code>
references, and appends a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release.renamed</span></code> event. Refuses a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">released</span></code>
source unless <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">force_released_unshipped</span></code> is set (the version number was
wrong but the release never actually shipped under that tag).</p>
</dd></dl>

class="pre">allow_canceled_predecessors</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">bool</span></a></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#dict" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">dict</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">[</span></span><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">,</span></span><span class="w"> </span><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">object</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">]</span></span></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/releaseledger/services/releases/#repair_release_chain"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Recompute predecessor links from release order and report/apply fixes.</p>
<p>Builds the canonical chain by sorting non-canceled releases by
(released_at, semantic version) and assigning each release’s
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">previous_version</span></code> to the release immediately before it (the first gets
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code>). Canceled releases are left untouched. With <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">apply_changes</span></code>
False this is a dry run that reports the planned changes; with True it
writes them, appends a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release.chain_repaired</span></code> event, and rebuilds
indexes.</p>
</dd></dl>

<dd><p>Update explicitly supplied release metadata.</p>
<p>Clearable optional fields use the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">UNSET</span></code> sentinel to distinguish
“not supplied” from “explicitly clear to None”. Each <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--clear-*</span></code> flag
conflicts with its matching setter option. Clearing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">released_at</span></code> on a
release whose effective status is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">released</span></code> is rejected unless
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">force=True</span></code>.</p>
</dd></dl>

<section id="module-releaseledger.api.changelog">
<span id="changelog-api"></span><h2>Changelog API</h2>
<p>Public changelog API re-exports.</p>
<p>Exposes both the source/context builder (<a class="reference internal" href="#releaseledger.api.changelog.build_changelog_context" title="releaseledger.api.changelog.build_changelog_context"><code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build_changelog_context()</span></code></a>) and
the final <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">CHANGELOG.md</span></code> build helpers (<a class="reference internal" href="#releaseledger.api.changelog.build_changelog_file" title="releaseledger.api.changelog.build_changelog_file"><code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build_changelog_file()</span></code></a>,
<a class="reference internal" href="#releaseledger.api.changelog.build_full_changelog_file" title="releaseledger.api.changelog.build_full_changelog_file"><code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build_full_changelog_file()</span></code></a>, <a class="reference internal" href="#releaseledger.api.changelog.render_changelog_section" title="releaseledger.api.changelog.render_changelog_section"><code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render_changelog_section()</span></code></a>,
<a class="reference internal" href="#releaseledger.api.changelog.render_full_changelog_document" title="releaseledger.api.changelog.render_full_changelog_document"><code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render_full_changelog_document()</span></code></a>). Internal template helpers are
intentionally not exported.</p>

href="../_modules/releaseledger/services/changelog_build/#build_changelog_file"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Render and optionally update the target changelog for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">version</span></code>.</p>
<p>Dry runs return <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">updated=False</span></code> with the rendered <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">section</span></code>. Non-dry
runs refuse an existing section for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">version</span></code> unless <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">replace_existing</span></code>
is set, then atomically write the merged changelog. Returns a deterministic
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">changelog_build</span></code> result payload.</p>
</dd></dl>

class="reference internal" href="../_modules/releaseledger/services/changelog_build/#build_full_changelog_file"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Rebuild the full changelog target from releaseledger state.</p>
<p>Selects releases whose status is in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">include_release_statuses</span></code> (default
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">released</span></code>) and never includes <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">canceled</span></code>. Renders each release section
newest-first using the existing single-release renderer, preserves the
existing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">##</span> <span class="pre">[Unreleased]</span></code> body when <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">preserve_unreleased</span></code> is true, and
regenerates the link-reference block deterministically. A whole-file rewrite:
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--replace-existing</span></code> does not apply.</p>
<p>Returns a deterministic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">changelog_full_build</span></code> payload.</p>
</dd></dl>

<dd><p>Render the final changelog section for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">version</span></code> without writing files.</p>
<p>Returns render metadata and the section text. The section has exactly one
trailing newline. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">section_heading</span></code> is the first <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">##</span></code> line in the
rendered section (or None if the template produced none).</p>
<p>If <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">template_name</span></code> is not <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&quot;default&quot;</span></code>, looks up the template profile
from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">config.changelog_templates[template_name]</span></code>. Raises <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LaunchError</span></code>
if the template is not found.</p>
</dd></dl>

href="../_modules/releaseledger/services/changelog_build/#render_full_changelog_document"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Assemble the full changelog document from rendered release sections.</p>
<p>Layout: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">#</span> <span class="pre">Changelog</span></code> title, optional preamble (Keep a Changelog mode), an
optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">##</span> <span class="pre">[Unreleased]</span></code> section preserving <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unreleased_body</span></code>, the
release sections newest-first, and finally the generated-by marker plus the
link-reference block. The result ends with exactly one newline.</p>
</dd></dl>

</section>

<section id="module-releaseledger.errors">
<span id="errors"></span><h2>Errors</h2>
<p>Typed exceptions and JSON error envelopes for releaseledger.</p>
<p>All releaseledger errors flow through <a class="reference internal" href="#releaseledger.errors.ReleaseledgerError" title="releaseledger.errors.ReleaseledgerError"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReleaseledgerError</span></code></a> (and the
<a class="reference internal" href="#releaseledger.errors.LaunchError" title="releaseledger.errors.LaunchError"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LaunchError</span></code></a> subclass that services raise). The CLI catches these at the
command boundary and turns them into the deterministic JSON error envelope.</p>

<dd><p>Raised by services/cli helpers for actionable, user-facing failures.</p>
<p>Services raise <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LaunchError</span></code> (never <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">typer.Exit</span></code> and never print) so the
CLI boundary can render either a human line or a JSON envelope.</p>
</dd></dl>

<section id="module-releaseledger.domain.release">
<span id="domain-models"></span><h2>Domain models</h2>
<p>Release record domain model.</p>
<p>A <a class="reference internal" href="#releaseledger.domain.release.ReleaseRecord" title="releaseledger.domain.release.ReleaseRecord"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReleaseRecord</span></code></a> is persisted as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release.md</span></code> with YAML front matter
(schema/version/status metadata) and an optional Markdown body holding the
release note. The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">note</span></code> field is the body and is therefore excluded from the
front-matter representation.</p>

callers can fall back to lexicographic ordering for non-standard versions.</p>
</dd></dl>

<p id="module-releaseledger.domain.entry">Release entry domain model.</p>
<p>A <a class="reference internal" href="#releaseledger.domain.entry.ReleaseEntryRecord" title="releaseledger.domain.entry.ReleaseEntryRecord"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReleaseEntryRecord</span></code></a> is persisted as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">entry-NNNN.md</span></code> inside a release
bundle. The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">body</span></code> field is the Markdown body of the file and is excluded from
front matter.</p>

<p>Accepts ledgercore global refs (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tl:task-0006</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">github:pr-42</span></code>) and
git commit refs (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">git:&lt;7..40</span> <span class="pre">hex&gt;</span></code>). Routes through
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">normalize_source_ref()</span></code> so git symbolic/range markers are rejected
with an actionable error.</p>
</dd></dl>
